note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The state is drawn exactly as supplied: 'gap' only leaves sheet B without entry and marks its blank rows; nothing is said about what a documentary gap means, and no chain-of-custody doctrine is drawn. Times are illustrative and imply no time limit. Editable brief fields: items, custodians, timestamps, records, actorLabels, objectLabels, actionProgress, annotations, finalState.
